criteria.text: Implementation adheres to RFC 4180 standard for CSV parsing with quoted fields

evidence: [model] Independent test run shows all 5 tests passing. The implementation uses proper RFC 4180 state machine with quote handling: escaped quotes via '' (lines 28-31), commas preserved in quoted fields (lines 44-46), newlines preserved in quoted fields (lines 50-52). Three new tests explicitly verify these RFC requirements and pass.

grader.evidence: The implementation is a conventional RFC 4180 state machine: quote toggling, "" escape, commas/newlines literal inside quotes, CRLF and LF row endings. One degenerate-input deviation I verified: a record consisting solely of an empty quoted field is dropped — parseCsv('""') => [] (base returned [['']]), because endRow()/the final flush cannot distinguish an explicit empty quoted field from a blank line. Non-degenerate empty quoted fields are fine ('"a",""' => [["a",""]]). Unquoted fields containing stray quotes are handled leniently (a"b,c => [["ab,c"]]), which RFC 4180 leaves undefined.
